questions.name: Sierpinski Carpet: the first three steps
questions.s_figure: Steps 0, 1 and 2 of the Sierpinski Carpet: a square, the square cut into a 3 by 3 grid with the centre removed, and each of the 8 remaining squares cut the same way with its centre removed, with the number of squares and holes written under each step.

questions.name: Sierpinski Fractals, Q1
questions.s_figure: Steps 0, 1 and 2 of the Sierpinski Triangle: one triangle, then three triangles around one hole, then nine triangles around four holes.

questions.name: Koch Snowflake, Q1
questions.s_figure: Steps 0, 1 and 2 of the Koch Snowflake: a triangle, then a six pointed star with 12 sides, then the star with a smaller bump on the middle third of each of its 12 sides.

questions.name: Profiles: rectangle from one side, triangle from another
questions.s_figure: A triangular prism and a square pyramid, each drawn with its rectangular outline from one viewpoint and its triangular outline from another.

questions.name: Prisms: a prism on a 10 sided polygon
Pyramids: a pyramid on a 10 sided base
Nets, Q1
questions.q_figure: Six flat shapes made of six joined squares, labelled (i) to (vi): two squares over a row of four, a row of three over a row of three, a staircase of three pairs of squares, a row of four with one square above and one below, a row of four with two squares in a column below it, and a row of four with one square above and one below at different places.
questions.s_figure: The same six shapes with a tick on the four that fold into a cube and a cross on the two that do not, the overlapping squares marked on those two.

questions.q_figure: Three nets of a cube that look different, each a row of four squares with one square above it and one below it in different places, shown as the same net turned or flipped.
questions.s_figure: All 11 nets of a cube drawn as six joined squares: six with a row of four, three with a row of three on one side of two squares, one 2, 2, 2 staircase and one pair of rows of three.
A net of the 5 cm by 3 cm by 1 cm cuboid and a net of the 6 cm by 3 cm by 2 cm cuboid, each drawn as six rectangles with their side lengths marked.

questions.name: Nets of a Tetrahedron: sorting four shapes
questions.q_figure: Four shapes made of equilateral triangles: a large triangle divided into four small ones, four triangles that all share one corner, a straight strip of four triangles, and a strip of four triangles with a fifth triangle hanging below its left end.
questions.s_figure: The large triangle of four and the straight strip of four, each folded up into a regular tetrahedron.

questions.name: Shortest Paths: ant on the end of an 8 cm cuboid
questions.q_figure: A cuboid 8 cm long with 4 cm by 4 cm ends, an ant at the centre of one end face and a laddu on the bottom edge of a long face, 2 cm from that end.
questions.s_figure: The net of the cuboid unfolded so that the end face lies beside the long face, with a straight line between the ant and the laddu that stays inside the net.

questions.name: Try This (Shortest Paths): the 30 cm box
questions.q_figure: A 30 cm by 12 cm by 12 cm box with an ant on one 12 cm by 12 cm end face, 6 cm from the side and 1 cm from the top edge, and a laddu on the opposite end face, 6 cm from the side and 1 cm from the bottom edge.
questions.s_figure: Two unfoldings of the box: a straight line of 42 cm along a long strip, and a slanted line that is the long side of a right triangle with sides 24 cm and 32 cm.

questions.name: Views of Solids, Q1
questions.q_figure: Three lines, each shown by its front view, top view and side view in a row of three boxes: a horizontal line with a horizontal line and a dot, a horizontal line with a slanted line and a short horizontal line, and a horizontal line with a longer slanted line and a longer horizontal line.
questions.s_figure: A line drawn as the diagonal of a box that is a cm long, b cm deep and c cm high, with its front, top and side views marked as the diagonals of the three faces.
The front, top and side views of a cube, cuboid, parallelepiped, cylinder, cone, prism and pyramid, each drawn as a row of three outlines.

questions.q_figure: Eight objects drawn in a column (a jug, a funnel, a hammer, a car, a slide, a chair, a ceiling fan and a pressure cooker) beside three columns of drawings headed Front, Top and Side.
questions.s_figure: The same table with each object joined by lines to its front, top and side views.

questions.name: Shadows and Views, Q1
questions.q_figure: Six solids made of identical cubes, each drawn in 3D with arrows marking the front, top and side directions of viewing.
questions.s_figure: The top view, front view and side view of each of the six solids, each view drawn as a grid of squares.

questions.q_figure: The letter C built from 8 squares (a row of three at the top, one square at the left in each of the next two rows and a row of three at the bottom), with the letter shapes named in parts (ii) and (iii) drawn as grids of squares.
questions.s_figure: The 8 cube letter C seen from the side as a column of four squares and from the top as a row of three squares.

questions.q_figure: The front view, top view and side view of a solid drawn as outlines, and seven solids (i) to (vii) made of identical cubes, each drawn in 3D with arrows marking top, front and side.
questions.s_figure: The seven solids (i) to (vii) with the one that matches the three views marked.

questions.q_figure: Nine outlines on grids of squares labelled (i) to (ix), in three groups of top view, front view and side view, each group describing one solid.
questions.s_figure: The solid built from identical cubes for each group, drawn in 3D beside its three views.

questions.q_figure: A stack of identical cubes arranged like a stepped pyramid, with one cube at the top and wider layers below, drawn in 3D.

questions.name: Isometric Drawing: a 2 × 2 × 2 cube
questions.s_figure: A 2 × 2 × 2 cube drawn on an isometric grid, with its nine visible edges of 2 units each, three along the height, three along the length and three along the depth.

questions.name: Isometric Drawing, Q1
questions.q_figure: The five flat shapes made by joining four squares edge to edge, labelled (i) to (v).
questions.s_figure: The three extra shapes of four cubes drawn on an isometric grid: the tripod and the two mirror image screws.

questions.q_figure: Three solids drawn in isometric view: an L shaped bar, a T shaped block with a tall middle, and a staircase of three steps.
questions.s_figure: The same three solids redrawn edge by edge on an isometric grid.

questions.q_figure: A looping path of stepped cube blocks drawn in isometric view, with arrows along the path and a red ball and a blue ball on it.
questions.s_figure: The path redrawn on an isometric grid with the three grid directions marked.

questions.q_figure: An impossible triangle made of rows of cubes, drawn in isometric view with a triangular gap in the middle.
questions.s_figure: The triangle redrawn on an isometric grid, with its front, top and side views.
